questions.stem: A 32-year-old pregnant female at 30 weeks gestation presents to the clinic with complaints of severe pruritus, particularly on her palms and soles, without any associated rash. She also reports dark urine and pale stools. On examination, her skin and sclerae are mildly jaundiced. Laboratory investigations reveal elevated serum bile acids and mildly elevated liver transaminases. Which of the following mutations is not typically associated with the condition?
